description:
This is the third of THREE unmissable games of Warhammer 40,000 using the new edition rules – streamed live from the Esports Stadium Arlington in Texas.

In a rematch of the 2025 Warhammer 40,000 World Championship final, Richard Siegler’s Adeptus Mechanicus forces face Liam VSL and his defiant Aeldari – featuring three Phoenix Lords!

Let’s see how the game plays in the hands of two of the world’s best Warhammer 40,000 players.
